# Anna Pogrebniak

> Fractional growth marketer for B2B SaaS, based in Ghent, Belgium and working across Europe. Eleven years of experience, 23 brands, EUR 3M in ad spend managed. Builds the marketing engine, runs the ads, and gets companies found in AI search. Founder of Awesome Marketers, a 2,000-member marketing community in Finland.

Anna works with European B2B SaaS companies as a fractional (part-time, senior) marketer, typically as the first or only marketing hire. She was the first marketing hire at three companies. She is strongest where marketing strategy and hands-on execution have to live in the same person, and where the sales cycle is long and enterprise-shaped.

## Services

- **Fractional growth**: the whole marketing function in one person. Growth strategy and ICP, demand generation, HubSpot and marketing operations, content and SEO, LinkedIn thought leadership, pipeline reporting.
- **Fractional ads**: paid acquisition on LinkedIn, Meta and Google. Full-funnel ad strategy, multi-market funnels, retargeting and light ABM, ad concepts, copy and creative. Ad budgets from EUR 3k to EUR 50k per month, currently around EUR 90k a month live across eight ad accounts.
- **Fractional AEO**: answer engine optimisation. AI visibility audits, prompt and mention tracking, comparison and alternatives pages, schema and structured data, and content that LLMs actually cite.
- **Pages, widgets and tools** (one-off projects, or alongside the fractional work): interactive reports, calculators and widgets embedded inside content, campaign landing pages, and full website rebuilds structured for AEO and SEO. Examples:
  - Interactive salary report, filterable by role, seniority and company size: https://awesomemarketers.fi/marketing-salary-finland-2026/
  - NPS calculator built into the article that explains NPS: https://www.hellocustomer.com/en/blog/how-to-calculate-nps
  - Campaign landing page for an AI visibility report: https://get.trustmary.com/ai-visibility-report/
  - Full B2B SaaS website rebuild, designed for AEO and SEO: https://www.hellocustomer.com/en/

## Selected results

- EUR 288k new ARR from ads in twelve months at 4.7:1 LTV:CAC, across five European markets on a EUR 250k yearly budget, for an enterprise sales-led platform with a six-month-plus sales cycle.
- 2.8x more visibility in Google's AI Overviews and other generative surfaces within a month of starting AEO work, measured across the whole site rather than one market.
- Hello Customer website rebuild (live 18 July 2026): Google AI Overview impressions about 3x per day within six weeks, pages cited in AI answers from 198 to 315, US AI impressions 7.6x; average Google position from 38 to 18 year on year with customer-logo junk traffic cut from 23% of impressions to under 1%; 24.5% citation share in Bing Copilot. Full write-up: https://awesomemarketer.fi/case-studies/hello-customer/
- Trustmary product launch, Finland (June to August 2026): 112 sales meetings at about EUR 150 blended cost per meeting on roughly EUR 5,000 to 7,000 a month across LinkedIn and Meta; meetings per month 20, 40, 52. Three paths compared: LinkedIn thought leadership plus retargeting (senior titles, about EUR 390 per attributed meeting), Meta direct product ads (about EUR 180), Meta webinar ads with email follow-up (about EUR 120 including the nurture sequence). Full write-up: https://awesomemarketer.fi/case-studies/trustmary/
- 49% of open pipeline already touched by ads before sales opened a conversation, via account-targeted paid LinkedIn.
- 50% of a EUR 1M open pipeline ad-influenced as a solo marketer, via paid LinkedIn and thought leadership content.
- 200 leads at EUR 20 CPL on a EUR 4k one-month budget for a new product launch. 5% lead-to-meeting blended, 15% on LinkedIn.
- Cost per MQL cut by 40% in three months after taking over an existing ad account at a PLG brand mid-repositioning.
- 150 ICP leads from a single webinar on a EUR 2.5k tools and ads budget, for a scale-up with no marketing investment for three years.
- A EUR 14.5k deal closed after a prospect attended three thought-leadership webinars, then returned for a fourth as a customer.

## Brands worked with

In-house: Lumoa (feedback analytics, Finland), Netigate (survey tech, Sweden), AddSearch (site search, Finland).
Agency-side: QPR Software (business intelligence, Finland), Shared Contacts for Gmail (France), AdvanceB2B (B2B SaaS agency, Finland), AIContentfy (AI content platform).
Fractional: Hello Customer (voice of customer platform, Belgium), Trustmary (Finland), Remotion (LinkedIn Ads agency), Tangently (Finland), Inklusiiv (Finland), Euro Car Wash.
Freelance SEO and link building: Droppe (Finland), Glassix.

## Skills

Marketing and growth strategy, LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Meta Ads, SEO, AEO and AI search visibility, demand generation, email nurture, marketing automation, HubSpot, marketing operations, ABM, lead scoring, content strategy, webinars, landing pages, interactive reports and in-content widgets, website builds, custom reporting dashboards, Claude and agentic AI.

## Tooling

Anna builds her own client reporting dashboards with Claude: budget pacing, per-creative performance and status tracking, refreshed daily across eight live ad accounts and three currencies.

## Free work

- **Awesome Marketers**: a 2,000-member marketing community in Finland. Events, an active Slack, and a yearly salary report for the Finnish market. https://awesomemarketers.fi
- **Mentoring**: free one-to-one sessions with marketers and founders on GrowthMentor. 20+ sessions so far, rated five stars.

## Key pages

- [Homepage](https://awesomemarketer.fi/): services, results, brands worked with, recommendations, and how she works.
- [About](https://awesomemarketer.fi/about/): background, how she works with teams, values, and a full summary.
- [Case study: Hello Customer](https://awesomemarketer.fi/case-studies/hello-customer/): a B2B SaaS website repositioned as a voice of customer platform and rebuilt SEO and AEO first, in three languages. Seven weeks after launch: 3x more Google AI Overview impressions per day, average Google position from page 4 to page 2, 24% citation share in Bing Copilot across 146 buyer questions.
- [Case study: Trustmary](https://awesomemarketer.fi/case-studies/trustmary/): a fractional ads case study. A new product (an AI visibility report) launched in the Finnish home market with three paid paths to one sales meeting: LinkedIn thought leadership ads with retargeting to product ads, Meta product ads, and Meta webinar ads leading to the offer. 112 meetings booked in June to August 2026 at a blended cost of about EUR 150, monthly budget about EUR 5,000 to 7,000. Anna built the ads, the landing pages and the daily reporting tool, and measured conversion at every touchpoint.
